book.name: 2 TIMOTI
book.title: TIMOTI ꞌINA LETA ꞌELUWENA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: ꞌIda losaiya Yesu Keliso manuna
Natugu Timoti, Yesu Keliso ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌuewaiwai
be tetelina ꞌuꞌitaꞌiꞌisi. Tetela nina ꞌeguyega ꞌunononaya tomota yaudi matadiya, ꞌenega taudi ma ꞌadi emisa ꞌediya ꞌuꞌebwayae, be taudi wate mali tomota sieꞌitadi.
Maiboꞌada Yesu Keliso manuna ꞌida miyamwau talobaloba. ꞌEnega ꞌimu miyamwau nina ꞌenaya ꞌutagwaleyo be ꞌoyo Yesu Keliso ꞌina tolosaiya boboꞌana.
ꞌUnuwaꞌiꞌisi ꞌaene tolosaiya nuwanuwana be ꞌana toloina namo ꞌina nuwanuwao ꞌiguiguinuwedi, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo ꞌina ꞌasa ꞌana paisewa manuna ꞌinuwanuwa.
Toepili nadigega, ꞌeguma epili ꞌana loina nigeya ꞌimulimuliyei, geyaꞌabo pali ꞌilobaloba.
Nadigega tobagula ꞌina paisewa waiwai manuna ꞌilobwenena be bagula uwana ꞌida gimilotoo.
ꞌIgu onao getedi ꞌunuwaꞌiꞌisidi, ta ꞌadi nuwasabwalena maiboꞌana ꞌida ꞌInapwana tauna ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌeyo.
Ta Yesu Keliso ꞌunuwaꞌiꞌisi, tauna Debida ꞌina susu, ta mwawasega ꞌitoolo limana, nadigega niꞌatu yasimanena ꞌigu loguguya ꞌena.
ꞌIgu loguguya nina manuna ꞌaboꞌagu niꞌatu miyamwau yalobena, ga deliya siyonigu, ꞌatuwa totoꞌumalina ꞌebweu. Ta Yaubada ꞌina ona geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu yaita ꞌigiegie losaꞌu.
Gete manuna ꞌigu miyamwau nidi getedi ꞌediyega yaeꞌalamaꞌiꞌita, be taudi Yaubada ꞌiesinuwediya yada lemedi, be ꞌaene Yesu Keliso ꞌiꞌetoseyedi, be gwausowala ataya sida loba.
Ona getedi onaꞌaiꞌaila ꞌaene: “ꞌEguma Keliso maꞌedai tamwamwawasa, maꞌetamo maꞌedai yawasida boboꞌana taloba.
ꞌEguma Keliso maꞌedai ꞌida miyamwau ꞌediya taeꞌalamaꞌiꞌita, maꞌetamo maꞌedai tada loina. ꞌEguma Keliso nina taeyaseyaseye maꞌetamo ꞌieyaseyaseyeda.
ꞌEguma nigeya ꞌida emisamo Keliso ꞌenaya, tauna ꞌina onaupaupa nigeya sawesawenaya ꞌiesaꞌu gelasedi, manuna tauna adelina ma ꞌana emisa.”
Yaubada ꞌina toguinuwao boboꞌadi

ꞌEnega Yaubada matanaya ꞌimu tomotaiyao ꞌuguguyadi ta ꞌuemataluwedi be ona getedi geyaꞌabo sinuwanuwa pupuledi, ta wate geyaꞌabo ona ꞌaidi ꞌadi gibui manudi siegewagewana. Manuna egewagewana besobeso nigeya sawesawenaya be toenono ꞌilemedi, ta esi ꞌigie toꞌumaliyedi.
ꞌEnega wate ꞌuetapewa waiwai be tetela boboꞌana ꞌana eꞌita ꞌaiꞌaila manuna ꞌugwaunuwa be ꞌaene ꞌoyo Yaubada ꞌina toguinuwa be maꞌetamo matanaya ꞌuapwesa be ꞌida ꞌawaboboꞌaneyo.
Ta toona besobeso bodadi geyaꞌabo ꞌediya ꞌulugulugu, manuna ona nidi egewagewana ꞌidi ꞌebe apwesa,
ta ona besobeso nidi toꞌumalina sinabwana ꞌina ꞌebe apwesa. Toona besobeso nidi ꞌeluwa ꞌadi esanao Aimenio be Pileto,
ga siteluwa nidi niꞌatu eꞌita ꞌaiꞌaila sipilisinena ta sigwae, “Tomwawasa ꞌidi toololimana ꞌana tuta niꞌatu,” ga ꞌaidi gosediyao ꞌidi kabo nina sinonona, ga ꞌenega ꞌidi emisa niꞌatu ꞌineneta.

Ta esi Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌana ꞌautui paꞌalina ꞌenaya lowa siꞌetoladina ꞌigwae: “ꞌInapwana ꞌina tomotaiyao ꞌimwalatonidi,” ta wate ꞌigwae, “Taudi ꞌInapwana ꞌena niꞌatu sitagwalediya, ꞌilobwenedi be ꞌidi bubuna toꞌumalidi siguitoyasedi.”

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, anuwa esaesa soladiya ꞌaina gaeba goula be siliba, ta ꞌaina gaeba kaiwe be bwaꞌa ꞌenega siguinuwedi. Ta gaeba nidi boboꞌadi ꞌowagao manudi sisaꞌudi, ta gaeba toꞌumalidi sisaꞌu dumedumedi sumwana manudi.
Ta ꞌenega nadigega ꞌabo yaita ꞌina bubuna toꞌumalina ꞌediyega tauna ꞌigieꞌesasa lima, tauna ꞌida egaeba boboꞌana, be ꞌina ꞌinapwana ꞌida aseye ꞌina guinuwa boboꞌadi manudi.
ꞌEnega tubuwau ꞌidi yalakwaiyao ꞌuguitoyasedi be bubuna palupaluna be emisa be oboboma be miyasiwalowa ꞌumuliyedi, be wate taudi Yesu siꞌawa ꞌinapwanena maꞌateꞌesasedi ꞌuetotowanedi.
Ta wate egewagewana besobeso ꞌupilisinedi, manuna egewagewana etalauwala ꞌina ꞌebe apwesa.
Ta egewagewana ꞌInapwana ꞌina toguinuwao nigeya ꞌilobwelobweneda, ta ꞌatenuwaꞌoleꞌole be eꞌita boboꞌana be ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita esi.
Ta wate ꞌada talauwalao ꞌediya ꞌida bubuna maꞌanuwaena ꞌenega tagiepaludi, be ꞌenega Yaubada, ꞌabo kapekapeyana, ꞌilemedi be sinuwaꞌebuni, be eꞌita ꞌaiꞌaila simuliyedi,
be wate Seitani ꞌina sikwa ꞌenega sidedena, manuna taudi Seitani lowa ꞌisikwedi, ga ꞌenaya sietoguinuwa ꞌina nuwanuwao manudi.
